component.name: Folio
component.summary: Tables, queries, forms and reports in one file

description.p: Folio is a friendlier take on the desktop database: your data lives in one plain SQLite file you can open anywhere.

ul.li: Tables in a spreadsheet-like datasheet, with typed columns, lookups through relationships, search, sorting and undo
Queries built by ticking fields and typing criteria, with the SQL shown live
Import and export CSV; a relationships diagram
Open, edit and create Microsoft Access files (.accdb, .mdb) in place, or convert them to and from Folio files

description.p: Open and edit Microsoft Access files (.accdb, .mdb) in place, and create new .accdb files, with no conversion.
Currency fields shown as money, a more comfortable datasheet, undeclared relationships found when importing Access files, and a larger, higher-contrast look.
First release: tables, queries, forms, reports and relationships on a SQLite file, with Access (.accdb) import and export.
